claude.sample_unit: LLM responses rated by expert reviewers

links.outcome: Clinical reasoning, diagnostic accuracy, and safety ratings with vs without structured literature excerpts in prompts
links.effect: Literature plus imaging plus text significantly improved clinical reasoning (F(3,123)=4.32, p=0.0058); no significant differences in diagnostic accuracy or safety across strategies.
links.quote: Combining structured literature and imaging with clinical text significantly improved clinical reasoning scores (F(3,123) = 4.32, p = 0.0058), ranking first or second in six of seven evaluation domains.

unlisted_practices: Multimodal prompting combining clinical text with medical imaging to improve LLM diagnostic reasoning

screen.reason: The study empirically tests whether augmenting a commercial foundation model (ChatGPT-4.0) with retrieval-augmented literature grounding and medical imaging improves diagnostic reasoning and safety over standard prompting across simulated clinical cases.
